hooks.command: input=$(echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$input" | grep -qE 'push.+main|push.+master'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Direct push to main/master is not allowed. Use a feature branch.' >&2; exit 1; fi

file=$(echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('path', d.get('file_path','')))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.env$|\.env\.'; then echo "BLOCKED: Writing to .env files is not allowed. Use environment variables or secrets manager." >&2; exit 1; fi

branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ "$branch" = "main" ] || [ "$branch" = "master" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: You are on '$branch'. Create and switch to a feature branch first: git checkout -b feature/SCRUM-{id}-{slug}" >&2; exit 1; fi

file=$(echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('path', d.get('file_path','')))" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$file" ] && [ -f "$file" ]; then if grep -qE '(password|secret|api_key|token)\s*=\s*["\x27][^"\x27]+["\x27]' "$file" 2>/dev/null; then echo "WARNING: Possible hardcoded credential detected in $file. Review before committing." >&2; fi; fi
